# rtichoke

> interactive visualizations for performance of predictive models

## Docs

### API Reference

#### Performance Data
> Prepare classification and time-to-event data for visualization.

- [prepare_performance_data](https://uriahf.github.io/rtichoke_python/reference/prepare_performance_data.html)
- [prepare_binned_classification_data](https://uriahf.github.io/rtichoke_python/reference/prepare_binned_classification_data.html)
- [prepare_performance_data_times](https://uriahf.github.io/rtichoke_python/reference/prepare_performance_data_times.html)
- [prepare_binned_classification_data_times](https://uriahf.github.io/rtichoke_python/reference/prepare_binned_classification_data_times.html)

#### Discrimination
> ROC, precision-recall, gains, and lift visualizations.

- [create_roc_curve](https://uriahf.github.io/rtichoke_python/reference/create_roc_curve.html)
- [create_roc_curve_times](https://uriahf.github.io/rtichoke_python/reference/create_roc_curve_times.html)
- [plot_roc_curve](https://uriahf.github.io/rtichoke_python/reference/plot_roc_curve.html)
- [create_precision_recall_curve](https://uriahf.github.io/rtichoke_python/reference/create_precision_recall_curve.html)
- [create_precision_recall_curve_times](https://uriahf.github.io/rtichoke_python/reference/create_precision_recall_curve_times.html)
- [plot_precision_recall_curve](https://uriahf.github.io/rtichoke_python/reference/plot_precision_recall_curve.html)
- [create_gains_curve](https://uriahf.github.io/rtichoke_python/reference/create_gains_curve.html)
- [create_gains_curve_times](https://uriahf.github.io/rtichoke_python/reference/create_gains_curve_times.html)
- [plot_gains_curve](https://uriahf.github.io/rtichoke_python/reference/plot_gains_curve.html)
- [create_lift_curve](https://uriahf.github.io/rtichoke_python/reference/create_lift_curve.html)
- [create_lift_curve_times](https://uriahf.github.io/rtichoke_python/reference/create_lift_curve_times.html)
- [plot_lift_curve](https://uriahf.github.io/rtichoke_python/reference/plot_lift_curve.html)

#### Calibration
> Calibration visualizations for classification and time-to-event models.

- [create_calibration_curve](https://uriahf.github.io/rtichoke_python/reference/create_calibration_curve.html)
- [create_calibration_curve_times](https://uriahf.github.io/rtichoke_python/reference/create_calibration_curve_times.html)

#### Utility
> Decision-curve analysis for classification and time-to-event models.

- [create_decision_curve](https://uriahf.github.io/rtichoke_python/reference/create_decision_curve.html)
- [create_decision_curve_times](https://uriahf.github.io/rtichoke_python/reference/create_decision_curve_times.html)
- [plot_decision_curve](https://uriahf.github.io/rtichoke_python/reference/plot_decision_curve.html)
